Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class RanzMarshallMassTransferCorrelation

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.RanzMarshallMassTransferCorrelation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RanzMarshallMassTransferCorrelation extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable Ranz-Marshall external-film mass-transfer correlation for spherical dispersions.

The caller supplies the Sauter mean diameter, continuous-phase density and dynamic viscosity, relative velocity, and one continuous-phase diffusivity for every component. The correlation evaluates Sh_i = 2 + 0.6 sqrt(Re) cbrt(Sc_i), k_i = Sh_i D_i / d32, and the external-film relaxation time tau_i = d32 / (6 k_i). No property, morphology, or component value is inferred.

This object evaluates the correlation for either gas bubbles or liquid droplets. A release-flow adapter must still supply a morphology-compatible hydrodynamic closure. The documented range is 0 <= Re < 200 and 0 < Sc_i < 250; values outside that range remain available for diagnostics but are not supported for release calculations.

  • Constructor Details

    • RanzMarshallMassTransferCorrelation

      public RanzMarshallMassTransferCorrelation(RanzMarshallMassTransferCorrelation.Morphology morphology, double sauterMeanDiameterM, double continuousPhaseDensityKgM3, double continuousPhaseDynamicViscosityPaS, double relativeVelocityMs, Map<String,Double> componentDiffusivitiesM2S, String parameterProvenance)
      Creates an explicit spherical-dispersion mass-transfer correlation.
      Parameters:
      morphology - explicit gas-bubble or liquid-droplet morphology
      sauterMeanDiameterM - caller-declared Sauter mean diameter d32 in m
      continuousPhaseDensityKgM3 - continuous-phase density in kg/m3
      continuousPhaseDynamicViscosityPaS - continuous-phase dynamic viscosity in Pa s
      relativeVelocityMs - dispersed-to-continuous relative speed magnitude in m/s
      componentDiffusivitiesM2S - continuous-phase diffusivity in m2/s for every component
      parameterProvenance - nonempty source or calibration identity for all supplied inputs
